summary.p95_scope: 20-sample descriptive quantile; no stable tail guarantee
summary.process_scope: fresh OS process, one facet, one serialized model load
summary.baseline_scope: deployed model ready after one-time LoRA merge parity if applicable; all CUDA facets synchronize/empty_cache once/synchronize before loaded baseline; before full V parity and warmups
summary.peak_reset_scope: after warmup and before every timed trial; reported peak is maximum across timed trials
summary.timing_scope: physical window and bool mask through fill/scaler/model/inverse/CPU output; window extraction and model load excluded

parity.scope: entire saved development V, original order, real physical-input inference

sampling.scope: warmups and timed trials plus inter-trial checks/hashing; model load and full V parity excluded

environment.CUDA_synchronization: before and after each timed whole path
